title: Reno Metric0 Field Completeness Score
dataSources: Renovation tasks (`reno:task`), budget and receipts (`reno:budget`), material orders (`reno:material`), inspections (`reno:inspection`), contractor logs (`reno:contractor`).
app: Home-renovation project management — task boards (Trello, Notion), budget and receipt trackers, material orders, and inspection / permit logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reno:metric0
| eval complete=if(isnotnull(value) AND isnotnull(duration_min),1,0)
| stats sum(complete) as complete_rows, count as total
| eval completeness_pct=round(100*complete_rows/total,1)
description: Measures how often reno metric0 events include both value and duration.
value: Incomplete exports break joins and dashboards; completeness scoring catches schema drift early.
implementation: Require `value` and `duration_min` on reno metric0 events and track completeness percentage.
visualization: Single-value gauge of field completeness percent.
grandmaExplanation: It tells you how often your reno metric0 exports arrive with the key numbers filled in.
